speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy with feeding difficulties and abdominal distension; can you tell me if you are vomiting, and if so, is it forceful or projectile?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The combination of an 8-month-old male with abdominal distension, feeding difficulties, and pain on abdominal palpation (crying when touched) is highly suspicious for intussusception. I am requesting an Ultrasound of the abdomen to confirm the diagnosis.
